spec.command:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p "$OUT/db"
cp store/jobs/j000145/out/contact/contact/apex.sqlite3 "$OUT/db/apex.sqlite3"
cp store/jobs/j000145/out/contact/contact/apex.sqlite3-wal "$OUT/db/apex.sqlite3-wal"
cp store/jobs/j000145/out/contact/contact/apex.sqlite3-shm "$OUT/db/apex.sqlite3-shm"
python3 - "$OUT/db/apex.sqlite3" "$OUT/apex-rows.json" <<'PY'
import sqlite3,sys,json,base64,re
p,o=sys.argv[1:]
c=sqlite3.connect(p)
rows=[]
for k,v in c.execute('select key,value from apex_stormcrow order by key'):
 b=bytes(v)
 rows.append({'key':k,'length':len(b),'hex':b.hex(),'base64':base64.b64encode(b).decode(),'utf8':b.decode('utf-8','replace'),'printable_strings':[x.decode('ascii','replace') for x in re.findall(rb'[\x20-\x7e]{4,}',b)]})
json.dump({'journal_mode':c.execute('pragma journal_mode').fetchone()[0],'integrity_check':c.execute('pragma integrity_check').fetchone()[0],'count':len(rows),'rows':rows},open(o,'w'),indent=2)
PY
cat "$OUT/apex-rows.json"
